name: python-cron-schedule
title: Cron schedule whose runs you can name
blurb: Parse a five-field cron expression into the set of values it means, then answer the only question that matters at 03:00: which UTC instants does it fire at, in a named time zone? Day-of-month and day-of-week are joined with OR when both are restricted, a local time that DST skips has no run, and a local time that DST repeats runs twice.
default_description: A cron expression evaluator that makes DST visible instead of surprising.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
